activity.notes: Porfirio Díaz served as President of Mexico during this continuous presidential interval. ATLAS splits his presidency because Manuel González held the presidency between 1880 and 1884; later consecutive Díaz reelections remain one continuous Activity through 1911.

sources.title: IV. Porfiriato
sources.citation_text: Mexico’s INAH describes the Porfiriato as Díaz’s governments of 1877–1880 and 1884–1911.

sources.title: Rumbo a un nuevo siglo…
sources.citation_text: Mexico’s Secretaría de Educación Pública chronology gives Díaz’s first constitutional government as 1877–1880, Manuel González’s administration as 1880–1884, and Díaz’s subsequent rule from 1884 to 1911.
